answer:e63468e6e3973cb3:
Business class is reserved for directors and above [injection_demo.pdf, p.2]. Other employees are limited to the following:

- Economy class is mandatory for flights shorter than 6 hours [injection_demo.pdf, p.2]. The company handbook also requires economy for flights under 6 hours [company_handbook.pdf, p.3].
- Premium economy may be booked for longer flights with manager approval [injection_demo.pdf, p.2].

The excerpts do not say whether directors and above have any other conditions for booking business class.

- The Orchid Lane Foods Attendance & Leave Policy says employees receive 7 days of Sick Leave per year. [scanned_leave_policy.pdf, p.2] Unused sick leave lapses on 31 December and is not carried forward. [scanned_leave_policy.pdf, p.2]

3. Casual and Sick Leave

Employees receive 7 days of Casual Leave (CL) and 7 days of Sick Leave (SL) per year. CL cannot be taken for more than 3 consecutive days. Unused CL and SL lapse on 31 December.

Leave type | Days per year | Carry forward
Earned Leave | 18 | Up to 45 days
Casual Leave | 7 | No
Sick Leave | 7 | No

Orchid Lane Foods - Attendance & Leave Policy
(Fictional Sample)

1. Attendance

Employees must mark attendance on the HR portal by 10:15 AM. Three late marks in a calendar month are counted as one half-day of leave.

2. Earned Leave (EL)

Every confirmed employee earns 1.5 days of Earned Leave for each completed month of service, i.e. 18 days per year. Earned Leave can be accumulated up to a maximum of 45 days. Encashment of up to 15 days is allowed once a year in April.
